entries.title: Psalms 93:1
segments: ¶The LORD reigns, He is clothed with majesty; The LORD is clothed, He has girded Himself with strength. Surely the world is established, so that it cannot be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 93:2
segments: Your throne [is] established from of old; You [are] from everlasting.

entries.title: Psalms 93:3
segments: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their waves.

entries.title: Psalms 93:4
segments: The LORD on high [is] mightier Than the noise of many waters, [Than] the mighty waves of the sea.

entries.title: Psalms 93:5
segments: Your testimonies are very sure; Holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, forever.
